purpose: Kimodo-like explicit interaction semantics that must be recognizable from the 18D robot motion unless a separate context mask is enabled.

visual_equivalence_rules.rule: The motion label remains wave_to_person because greeting and farewell waves are not reliably distinguishable from robot motion alone.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Hold an attentive upright posture toward the person.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 面向对方保持专注、直立的待机姿态。
intents.visual_signature: Stable upright posture with deliberate orientation and only small settling motion.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Lean in slightly and give small listening acknowledgements toward the speaker.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 略微前倾，并朝说话者做小幅倾听回应。
intents.visual_signature: Small intermittent nods or forward engagement while otherwise yielding the turn.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Raise one hand and wave it side to side toward the person.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 抬起一只手，朝对方左右挥动。
intents.visual_signature: One raised forearm performs at least two lateral wave cycles toward a person, then lowers or settles.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Extend one arm and repeatedly draw the hand inward to beckon the person closer.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 伸出一只手并反复向内收，引导对方靠近。
intents.visual_signature: Repeated distal-to-proximal pulls directed from the other person toward the robot.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Raise one hand clearly and hold it to get the person's attention.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 明确举起一只手并短暂停住，以引起对方注意。
intents.visual_signature: A clear single arm raise followed by a hold; no repeated lateral or inward wave cycles.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Bring one hand to the forehead in a clear salute, hold briefly, then lower it.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 将一只手抬到额前做出清晰敬礼，短暂停住后放下。
intents.visual_signature: One hand travels directly to the forehead or temple, holds, and returns.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Bend the head and upper body forward in a deliberate bow, then return upright.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 头部和上身有意向前俯下鞠躬，然后恢复直立。
intents.visual_signature: Coordinated forward head and torso inclination with a hold or clear apex and upright recovery.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Present an arm firmly toward the person to signal stop.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 坚定地将手臂朝向对方，示意停止。
intents.visual_signature: A rapid assertive arm presentation followed by a firm held boundary pose.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Extend one arm to point clearly toward the robot's left side.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 伸出一只手臂，清楚指向机器人左侧。
intents.visual_signature: One arm establishes and holds an unambiguous leftward direction.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Extend one arm to point clearly toward the robot's right side.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 伸出一只手臂，清楚指向机器人右侧。
intents.visual_signature: One arm establishes and holds an unambiguous rightward direction.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Extend one arm to point clearly forward toward the target.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 伸出一只手臂，清楚指向前方目标。
intents.visual_signature: One arm establishes and holds a forward target direction.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Give a clear repeated vertical nod to show agreement.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 做出清晰、重复的上下点头，表示同意。
intents.visual_signature: At least two deliberate pitch-down and recovery cycles without whole-body bowing.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Turn the head side to side repeatedly to signal no.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 反复左右摇头，表示否定。
intents.visual_signature: At least two deliberate yaw alternations centered on the listener.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Bring both hands together repeatedly in applause.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 双手反复合拢，做出鼓掌动作。
intents.visual_signature: Both forearms repeatedly converge symmetrically at the front centerline.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Lift both arms in a clear celebratory motion and hold the success pose briefly.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 清楚地抬起双臂庆祝，并短暂保持成功姿态。
intents.visual_signature: Fast expansive bilateral arm lift with a distinct high apex and energetic recovery.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Lean gently toward the person and extend an arm in a restrained comforting reach.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 轻柔地靠向对方，并克制地伸出手臂表示安慰。
intents.visual_signature: Slow soft approach with one arm and an open, non-forceful upper-body posture.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Open both arms toward the person and hold an inviting hug posture.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 朝对方张开双臂，并保持邀请拥抱的姿态。
intents.visual_signature: Bilateral arms open outward and forward into a sustained receiving pose.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Raise one arm toward the person and hold it ready for a high five.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 朝对方抬起一只手臂并保持，准备击掌。
intents.visual_signature: Single forward-high arm presentation held for a partner response.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Move both forearms outward toward the person in a clear rejecting push-away gesture.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 双前臂明确朝外推开，向对方表示拒绝。
intents.visual_signature: One or two arms press outward from near the torso, often with upper-body withdrawal.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Lift both shoulders and forearms in a compact shrug, then release.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 双肩和双前臂做出紧凑耸肩动作，然后放松。
intents.visual_signature: Brief symmetric shoulder and elbow lift with compact outward forearm opening.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Turn the head and upper body to scan deliberately across the surroundings.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 有目的地转动头部和上身，扫描周围环境。
intents.visual_signature: Sequential oriented looks to distinct directions with pauses that imply inspection.

intents.name_en: lean in for a curious look
intents.canonical_prompt_en: Tilt and lean the head toward the target for a closer curious look.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 头部倾斜并靠近目标，做出好奇探看的动作。
intents.visual_signature: Asymmetric head tilt plus forward or lateral approach toward a stable target.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Pull the arms inward and turn the head and upper body away from the person.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 双臂向内收，同时将头部和上身从对方方向转开。
intents.visual_signature: Contracting arm motion combined with a sustained head or torso orientation away from the partner.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Let the head and upper body sink into a sustained disappointed slump, then recover slowly.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 头部和上身持续下沉，表现失望低落，然后缓慢恢复。
intents.visual_signature: Slow downward head and torso collapse with reduced arm energy and a delayed recovery.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Start to reach, pause indecisively, then retract the arm toward the body.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 先伸手、犹豫停顿，再将手臂收回身体。
intents.visual_signature: Incomplete reach with a distinct pause or reversal before the target is reached.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Use measured outward arm gestures to present information to the listener.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 用有节制的向外手臂动作向听者展示信息。
intents.visual_signature: Turn-yielding open-arm presentation gestures aligned with a speaker segment.

intents.canonical_prompt_en: Extend one bent forearm toward the person and hold it ready for a fist bump.
intents.canonical_prompt_zh: 朝对方伸出一只弯曲前臂并保持，邀请碰拳。
intents.visual_signature: A compact forward forearm presentation held at mid height for a partner response.

explicit_exclusions.reason: The 18D robot representation has no finger articulation.
The current representation has no facial degrees of freedom.
Greeting versus farewell is a pragmatic role, not a reliably distinct wave trajectory.
This ontology is interaction-first; dance-style waving is not evidence for wave_to_person.
